caption_L1: Here a bar diagram is labeled Countries with the highest number of reported cases of cholera in 2013. There is a linear scale from 0 to 60,000 on the y-axis, marked Number of reported cases. A categorical scale with Angola on one end and Somalia at the other can be found on the x-axis, labeled Country.
caption_L2L3: Haiti had the higher number of cases by a significant margin, twice the number of cases of DC Congo that had the second highest number of cases. Mozambique, the Congo  and the Dominic Republic all had the same lowest cases numbers.
